Written September 29, 2026
SECRET GARDEN HOIAN restaurant
Dear Mrs. Skye TIERNAN,

We are writing to address your claims directly, as our CCTV footage clearly shows a completely different version of events.

Perhaps posting a failure narrative makes you feel better, as a way of taking revenge on someone who did not satisfy you at dinner. And, in fact, you did a very good job of making someone endure your fierce smear campaign.

Your claim that you waited “over an hour” is simply untrue and, frankly, reflects very poorly on you. According to our CCTV timestamps, exactly 13 minutes after you placed your order, the first two dishes, Wonton and Cao Lau, were served. Just six minutes later, your Chicken in Claypot and Chicken Burger arrived at your table.

The only dish that was delayed was the Pasta. During the final quality check, our Chef noticed that the noodles were undercooked and insisted on remaking the dish rather than serving something that did not meet our standards. Before the freshly prepared pasta could even reach your table, however, you rejected the entire meal and walked out.

The entire event, from the moment you placed your order until you left, lasted less than 30 minutes. You walked away leaving almost a full table of freshly prepared food completely wasted, and then had the audacity to post a fabricated version of what happened online.

Where was your conscience when you wasted an entire table of cooked food and then posted false reviews to attack a business?

We only wish TripAdvisor allowed us to post the relevant CCTV screenshots here so that the facts could be publicly seen for themselves.

Furthermore, using our official Business Page to shamelessly advertise another establishment is a serious violation of review guidelines and demonstrates a total lack of respect for basic standards of decency.

The only thing we apologise for is not asking about your serving preference. You ordered five dishes consisting of both Starters and Main Courses, without giving us any special instructions, so we naturally served the Starters first for sharing. Yes, we acknowledge that we should have clarified your preference during a busy service, but that in no way justifies what we consider to be a spiteful attempt at revenge.

Sadly, TripAdvisor and many other social media platforms nowadays have become places where people can use public reviews as a tool for revenge or as an outlet for their frustration and stress. What these platforms often fail to recognise is that no one working in the service industry sets out to disappoint a customer. This is especially true in a fiercely competitive market such as Hoi An, where people earn very modest wages yet devote their time and effort to doing their best to please their customers.

After reconsidering what happened, perhaps you and your children may not bless yourselves through this experience, but we will.

Best regards,

Secret Garden team in Hoi An

Terrible experience: serious negligence with allergens and dirt in the food
Sep 2026 • Family
I don't usually leave bad reviews, but what we experienced here is unacceptable and a health risk for people with celiac disease.
To start, we clearly indicated that we needed a basic rice dish for a person with celiac disease. The dish arrived covered in sesame seeds (without warning). When we pointed out the possible contamination and expressly asked for a new dish, they committed the negligence of taking the same dish to the kitchen, scraping the sesame off the top layer, and bringing it back to us. We had to stand firm and demand that they cook a dish from scratch. Treating celiac disease with such ignorance is dangerous.
As if that weren't enough, in another one of the dishes we found pieces of inedible paper mixed in with the food. An absolutely unacceptable failure of hygiene and quality control.
A place that does not respect the food safety of its customers nor maintain the minimum standard of hygiene. I do not recommend it at all.

Written September 3, 2026
SECRET GARDEN HOIAN restaurant
Dear Ms. Berta P,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We take all guest reviews seriously and have thoroughly investigated the details of your visit. Furthermore, we carefully reviewed your transaction history to verify the facts. 

According to our system, your table ordered the following items:
1. TEA - Lemon Iced Tea (2 glasses): 80,000 đ (~$3.15)
2. BEER - Saigon Special (2 bottles): 96,000 đ (~$3.78)
3. WATER - Alba Still (2 bottles): 44,000 đ (~$1.73)
4. FOOD - 52 - Set Spring roll (2 portions): 442,000 đ (~$17.40)
5. Steamed rice (4 portions): 100,000 đ (~$3.94)
Total Bill: 762,000 đ (~$30.00)

Looking at your bill and notes, our team were never informed of any sesame allergy, nor were we made aware of any gluten-free dietary requirements when you ordered. Your order was simply a standard set of spring rolls and rice.

EVEN SO, we immediately swapped out two fresh plates of rice for your TWO YOUNG CHILDREN, despite the fact that your table had already accepted the first two plates with sesame seeds without any objection.

As for the paper, we strictly do not use paper napkins or tissues anywhere in our kitchen at all, especially for plain steamed rice. Rice is served directly from the steamer straight onto clean plates. Our CCTV footage also confirms the whole process, from steamer to plate to your table and no paper was used for cleaning or anything else.

Our kitchen is built to be completely open, and we are fully confident in welcoming guests to step inside, interact with our team, and inspect our food safety and prep procedures firsthand.

Moreover, if paper had actually been mixed into the rice during preparation, it would have been wet and stuck tightly to the rice. Instead, this was a fairly large piece of paper that was clearly dry. Is it possible that someone accidentally dropped paper into the plate after the rice was already served at your table?

We sincerely apologize that your experience didn't go smoothly, but we kindly ask that you review the whole situation fairly, without twisting what happened or making baseless claims against us.

Sincerely,
Secret Garden Team in Hoi An.
